question.text: Two rods of equal length and diameter have thermal conductivities 3 and 4 units respectively. If they are joined in series, the thermal conductivity of the combination would be

solution.text:
In series $R=R_1+R_2$
$\begin{aligned} & \frac{2 \ell}{K_{e f f} A}=\frac{\ell}{K_1 A}+\frac{\ell}{K_2 A} \\ & K_{e f f}=\frac{24}{7}=3.43\end{aligned}$
